subject: Film & Cinema
title: AI-Generated Film: Promise or Threat?
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: AI-Generated Film: Promise or Threat?.

hook.text: An AI can now generate a video clip from a text prompt. Filmmakers are divided.

buildup.text: Tools like Sora and Runway can produce images that once required entire crews.

discovery.text: The technology threatens jobs but also democratizes access to visual storytelling.

twist.text: Every past technology panic — sound, TV, CGI — created new art forms instead of destroying cinema.

climax.text: Whether AI becomes a tool or a replacement depends on choices humans make now.

punchline.text: The tool doesn't decide. The filmmaker does.

quiz.question: What historical pattern does AI filmmaking follow?
options: Each technology panic has led to new art forms
